series.summary: Professor Sanchez breaks his sobriety to build Morty a portal home, but the foster family ambushes them before a lethal test reveals the rift is deadly.

title: Rick Builds A Lethal Portal Part 5

cuts.voiceover_text: Morty was trapped thousands of lightyears from home, convinced nobody was coming for him. As the boy broke down sobbing in bed, Professor Sanchez stepped inside. The retired scientist had sworn off multidimensional travel forever, but watching Morty unravel shattered his resolve. Pulling the boy into a tight hug, he promised to secretly build a portal.

Hours later in the garage, Rick broke his sobriety to complete the machine, only for the foster family to ambush them with a rifle. Jerry furiously confronted Rick, demanding to know if this drunken contraption had ever been tested. Rick scoffed and shoved the pet cat straight into the swirling rift. Seconds later, the creature dropped back out mutilated and lifeless. Morty recoiled in pure terror. His only way home was a death trap.
